_about: The house's own ring images, not Shopify's: AI renders (Nano Banana) of the shop's DSC photographs, padded onto white at 1500px — from iCloud heroes-white-1500 (179 files, see its _REVIEW.txt). heroes: an image put first on a Shopify piece (by handle). instead: the house's own images shown in place of a Shopify piece's (by handle) — its box photographs of sets Shopify shows on white (the owner, 2026-09-28). pieces: rings known only from these images, no price (Price on request); name, collection, plating and stones were read off the image on 2026-09-23 and may be corrected. also: more images of the same piece; photoPlating: which plating an image shows. held: images deliberately not shown, with the reason. Originals live on the server at /catalog-src/local/<id>.png (never in git). Bangles and bracelets (ids bb-NNN.jpg, 2026-09-23): the photographs in ~/Downloads/House of Mina — Bangles & Bracelets 3.pdf, extracted by their No.; story is that catalogue's description. Its 22 pieces already on Shopify are not repeated, and its 25 Taheri photographs (green-backdrop shoots, 'new — Taheri' in the item list) are held. Shopify products and drafts: on 2026-09-23 renders here were paired with 42 of them as lead images (heroes); the owner said those were different pieces (2026-09-24), so every render is its own piece again and heroes is empty. Gents' natural ruby rings (ids DSC075NN-v2.jpg, 2026-09-23): the owner's own photographs (Sony RAW, ~/Downloads/New Folder With Items 3), the whole frame (1333×2000, portrait), brightened (shadows and midtones lifted, the warm cast eased) because the owner found them too dark; the first, square crops (DSC075NN.jpg) are no longer used; 13 rings, each its own stone, named Natural Ruby Ring No. 1–13 in shoot order (short enough that the number shows on a desktop card). They are set with natural rubies (the owner's words), so `natural: true` keeps their text as written, with no 'simulated'. Sets from Instagram posts (ids PHOTO-2026-….jpg, 1080px, 2026-09-23): the three not already on the site; four more from the same batch were here already (Ruby Line, Pavé Fan Bridal, Aqua Bloom, Sapphire Two-Row) and are not repeated. Rings from Gemini renders (ids ring-0N-….jpg, 2026-09-23; output/imagegen/mina-catalogue-2026-09-23 in taheri-shop): six, each its own piece (the owner, when some looked like Shopify rings). Lockets (ids lk-NN.jpg, 2026-09-24; ~/Downloads/New Folder With Items 4, `src` gives each file): 34 images, 30 pieces, in the Lockets category. Every one is AI-drawn, so fine inscriptions (the verse coins, the engraved locket, the filigree cells) are not legible Arabic; the large Allah, Kalma and Ali calligraphy reads true. Verse coins are named 'Calligraphy Coin' until the owner says which verse each carries. Box photographs, 2026-10-14 (the owner's Drive folder "hom bracelet and ring sets", DSC09597–09642, retouched 1254² PNGs in the maroon Mina box): 38 were new shots of bangle-and-ring sets already here, all bb-NNN pieces from the bangles PDF; each box photo is that piece's lead (heroes, keyed by the local piece's handle — the owner: "keep the box photos as the hero"), the PDF photo second. DSC09613 shows the Emerald Bypass design in rhodium. Six are new pieces. Shoot of 2026-10-16 (the owner's Drive folders, DSC09661–09676, retouched 1254² PNGs): ten rings on white, four pairs of hoops and two bangles on a pine block, new local pieces named off the photo; the agate calligraphy pendants of the same shoot (DSC09643–09660) are not added yet (the owner: 'ignore for now').
